# Enrich Skills

Please enrich all scaffolded skill stubs with real domain knowledge from the PRD.

## Steps

1. Read the PRD, `mao.config.yaml`, and `project-context.md`
2. Load the `skill-enrichment` skill
3. Find all `<!-- ENRICHMENT WILL FILL THIS -->` markers
4. Fill each stub with extracted domain knowledge
5. Add traceability comments and confidence levels
6. Present a summary of enriched files and any items needing human review
